answer:032ad0ed-e965-4eb0-9707-e4765a8ab: Yes. All connections use TLS 1.2 or higher. Older protocol versions are disabled at the load balancer.
answer:3e7e7e46-a3fc-4e9c-a8f5-71717833e: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:e927ed44-b776-4e23-afd9-56f6063a8: Yes. Customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 with keys managed by our cloud provider's key management service.
answer:f1a4a259-8e55-4580-8428-acf1dc2d0: Yes. Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider. SMS is not an accepted factor.
